title: UBTECH, FAW-Volkswagen partner on humanoid robots for logistics and smart manufacturing
source_used: Gasgoo (its text reads as the companies' joint statement)
key_facts: UBTECH Robotics and FAW-Volkswagen have a strategic partnership to develop and test embodied-intelligence robots for logistics operations.
The partners plan demonstration scenarios for humanoid robots in smart manufacturing.
FAW-Volkswagen runs five production bases, and its Volkswagen, Audi and JETTA portfolios have 35 models in production.
UBTECH says its humanoid robot factory, designed for production at a 10,000-unit scale, has begun operations.
UBTECH says its comparison of peers' financial statements puts it first globally in total revenue and humanoid robot sales.
Several UBTECH product lines are expected to ramp up and begin deliveries in the second half of 2026.
quote_evidence: UBTECH Robotics and FAW-Volkswagen have entered into a strategic partnership to develop and test embodied-intelligence robots for logistics operations.
UBTECH said its humanoid robot factory, designed for production at the 10,000-unit scale, has begun operations.
why_it_matters_hint: Car makers are testing humanoid robots for logistics and factory lines.
notes: The first-globally ranking is UBTECH's own comparison. No independent check of the volumes or claims.
